name: snapkit-debug-sync
description: Debug Dashboard-selected Flutter and React Native devices without modifying project files; fall back to normal IDE debugging offline.

commands.title: Snapkit: Debug React Native on Selected Devices
Snapkit: Reload All React Native Debug Sessions

snapkit.useDashboardTargets.description: Use Dashboard targets for native Run/Debug when the local agent is available and the project matches. Otherwise use the normal IDE configuration.

enumDescriptions: Keep the selected IDE profile's entrypoint, flavor, Dart defines and arguments. Snapkit supplies selected devices only.
Use the entrypoint, flavor and Dart defines saved in Snapkit project settings for all selected devices.
snapkit.flutterLaunchConfiguration.description: Choose the Flutter launch configuration when using Dashboard targets. Applies to the next debug run. Active Teams sessions use the configuration prepared in Teams.

snapkit.agentUrl.description: Loopback HTTP address of the local Snapkit agent. Debugging continues normally when this agent is offline.

snapkit.syncFlutterRestart.description: The IDE Restart button also hot restarts other running Flutter debug sessions.
